name: Martin Marietta Materials
description: Martin Marietta is a natural-resource company: it digs crushed stone, sand and gravel from about 400 quarries, mines and yards in 28 states, Canada and the Bahamas, and aggregates produced 88% of its segment gross profit in 2025. Aggregates are heavy and local, so it sells to highway and infrastructure agencies (37% of shipments) and to commercial and residential builders within a short truck, rail or barge haul. It also sells ready-mixed concrete, asphalt and paving in a few markets, and a Specialties business of magnesia and dolomitic lime. In 2024 it sold its South Texas cement business to CRH for $2.1B and bought BWI Southeast aggregates for $2.05B; a swap with Quikrete closed Feb 23, 2026.

businessLines.name: East Group (aggregates and asphalt)
businessLines.how: Sells aggregates by the ton to builders and road agencies; pricing per ton rises with local demand and quarry scarcity.
businessLines.description: Aggregates and asphalt in the eastern US.

businessLines.name: West Group (aggregates, ready mixed concrete, asphalt, paving)
businessLines.how: Aggregates by the ton plus concrete by the cubic yard, asphalt and paving contracts; lower-margin vertical integration.
businessLines.description: Aggregates plus downstream products and services in the western and central US.

businessLines.name: Specialties (magnesia and dolomitic lime)
businessLines.how: Sells specialty chemical products to environmental, industrial and agricultural customers on orders; heavily dependent on rail transport.
businessLines.description: High-purity magnesium oxide, hydroxide and sulfate and dolomitic lime from Ohio, Michigan, Nevada, North Carolina, Indiana and Pennsylvania; Premier Magnesia acquired July 25, 2025.
